gallery.title: Dendrogram with Radial & Area Profiles
gallery.description: A horizontal Dendrogram replaces all fifteen node dots with two monthly profiles: a sector-based Radial Stacked Bar on the left and an Area Chart on the right. Internal nodes and leaves both retain their own observations.

file.name: tree_nodes.csv
file.description: 180 rows: fifteen nodes observed over twelve months in 2025. node_id and parent_id define the tree; month and metric_1–metric_5 supply each node’s profiles. The tree uses one structural record per node while both nested charts keep the full monthly observations.

gallery.composition: Enter the Dendrogram node level and nest the Radial Stacked Bar (Sector) on every node, offset to the left. Nest the Area Chart on the same nodes, offset to the right. Hide the original node dots so each pair of charts replaces its node. The taller layout creates a nearly square composition. Each child inherits only its node_id, preserving all twelve months for that node.

editorHelp.introduction: The horizontal Dendrogram, sector Radial Stacked Bar, and Area Chart are already on the canvas. Nest the two profile blocks one at a time.

steps.title: Drag radial profiles onto the tree nodes
steps.source: Radial Stacked Bar (Sector) on the canvas
steps.action: Hold the Radial Stacked Bar and drag through the Dendrogram’s central Enter circle. Keep holding, move to a node dot, and release when Nested appears.
steps.result: Radial profiles repeat on all fifteen nodes, including internal nodes and leaves.

steps.title: Place radial profiles on the left
steps.target: Left side of each Dendrogram node
steps.action: In the nested configuration, set Offset X to -78 and Offset Y to 0. Keep Show parent element enabled until the Area Chart has also been nested.
steps.result: The original node dots stay available as targets for the second drag.

steps.title: Drag areas onto the same nodes
steps.target: Dendrogram center → an original node dot
steps.action: Hold the Area Chart, pass through Enter if the node level is closed, and move to an original Dendrogram node dot. Release when Nested appears; aim at the tree node rather than a radial sector.
steps.result: Each node now has both monthly profiles, inheriting node_id so all twelve months are preserved.

steps.title: Place areas on the right
steps.target: Right side of each Dendrogram node
steps.action: Set Offset X to 80 and Offset Y to 0 for the Area Charts. Adjust the child sizes to keep the two profiles separate, then turn off Show parent element to hide the original dots.
steps.result: Each tree node is represented by a radial profile on the left and an area profile on the right.
